alt: The Race step: nine race cards with Elf selected, a detail panel listing the elf's traits as chips, High Elf chosen as the subrace, and a summary column on the right showing Dexterity 12 = Base 10 + Elf 2.
caption: The Race step. Every choice changes the summary at once, and any number opens to show where it came from.

alt: The Rules step: five switches, for multiclassing, feats, hit points after 1st level, encumbrance and moving a race's ability increases, with Feats set to On and hit points to Rolled.
caption: The optional rules, one switch each. Every rule has a default, so a new character starts at Race and never has to visit this page.

alt: The Abilities step set to Roll: six sets of four dice, the lowest die of each crossed out, with their totals, above a table for giving each total to an ability.
caption: Rolling 4d6 and dropping the lowest, in the app. Every set stays in the roll log, so a DM can see the real results.

alt: The Class step for a level 5 character: the Level box, and Other classes listed with a minus and plus button each, one level given to Wizard, and most other classes marked in red with the scores they need and the scores the character has.
caption: Levels 1 to 20 and multiclassing. Each class shows the scores it needs, and the first class keeps every level the others don't take.

alt: The Equipment step with the Fighter's package: chain mail and a martial weapon and shield chosen, a grid of martial weapons with their damage, and the summary showing Armor Class 19 = Chain Mail 16 + Shield 2 + Fighter 1, with attack rows for a warhammer and a handaxe.
caption: Equipment from the class and background packages. Worn armour sets the Armor Class, and every weapon gets an attack row.

alt: The starting gold route: 120 gold entered, a running total of 25 gp spent and 95 gp left, the bought leather armour and longsword, and a search for armour with the items too expensive to buy greyed out.
caption: Starting gold and the shop. SRD 5.1 has no starting-wealth dice, so you enter what your DM gives you; you can't buy what you can't afford.

alt: The inventory editor: carried items with minus and plus buttons, torches down from 5 to 3, a silk rope added free, and a home-made item, a dragon's tooth, with its quantity, weight and note.
caption: The inventory keeps changing in play: used-up torches, loot, your own items and money all update the weight and the purse.

alt: The wizard's cantrip list: rows with each spell's school, casting time, range and duration, three cantrips chosen, and Fire Bolt greyed out as already known from the High Elf.
caption: The Spells step. All 319 SRD spells, with search, filters and full text; a spell you already have elsewhere can't be picked twice.

alt: The character sheet for Borin Stonehelm, Hill Dwarf Fighter 4 / Wizard 1: ability score tiles, combat numbers such as Armor Class 19 and 52 hit points, and saving throws and skills with dots marking proficiency.
caption: The character sheet, laid out by the rules module and drawn by the app, which knows nothing about D&D.

alt: The same sheet as printed: black on white without the app's header, step list or summary, with the identity block, ability scores, combat numbers, saving throws, skills, attacks and features.
caption: As printed: black on white, without the app around it. Feature and spell text and the session journal print only when asked for.

alt: The Race step on a phone: one column of race cards, the High Elf chosen, and a Next button fixed at the bottom of the screen.
caption: On a phone: one column and a Back and Next bar. Every page is checked for WCAG 2.2 AA at both sizes.

alt: The character sheet on a phone: one column, with the identity block, ability scores three to a row, the combat numbers and the start of the saving throws.
caption: The sheet on a phone: one column, nothing scrolling sideways.
